products.name: Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) — Commercial
products.short_description: Remove standing local admin rights. Let users run as standard while only the apps you approve elevate — controlled, audited, deployed by you with self-guided, tested steps for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
End standing local admin — without breaking the work that needs elevation

Permanent local administrator rights are the largest unmanaged risk on most Windows fleets. A user who is always an admin can install anything, disable your security tools, and turn one phished click into a full device compromise. But you can't just strip admin rights — a handful of apps and tasks legitimately need to elevate. Microsoft Intune Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) breaks that trade-off: everyday users run as standard users, and only the specific applications you approve are allowed to elevate — automatically, with a justification prompt, or via explicit support approval — every action centrally governed and fully audited.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Endpoint Privilege Management. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact Intune navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) that observes real elevations first, with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know rules cover real-world usage before you remove anyone's admin rights.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what EPM is, the three elevation types (automatic, user-confirmed, support-approved), and exactly which model to use.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (the Intune Suite / EPM add-on license, the EPM client, supported Windows, network) with how to verify it and how to implement it if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, click-by-click Microsoft Intune steps: enable EPM, deploy the base policy, build certificate/hash elevation rules, pilot, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — device-readiness discovery, deployment validation, tenant-wide elevation reporting (Microsoft Graph), safe remediation, and a rule-builder that reads an app's signer certificate and SHA-256 hash for you.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Least privilege in practice: standing local-admin rights removed from everyday users, the legitimate elevations allowed in a controlled and audited way, and a tenant-wide record of every privileged action — deployable by a single administrator in a controlled pilot within a day.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EPM-Discovery.ps1 — Endpoint Privilege Management device readiness check
    • EPM-ElevationReport.ps1 — Tenant-wide Endpoint Privilege Management elevation report
    • EPM-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation for Endpoint Privilege Management devices
    • EPM-Validation.ps1 — Confirms Endpoint Privilege Management is deployed and healthy
    • New-EpmElevationRule.ps1 — Read a target app's identity to author an EPM elevation rule

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
